title: Immutable source/provenance preflight

commands.note: fetched 4 pinned commits into new directories

findings: The published @colbymchenry/codegraph root package is a thin installer around a per-platform bundle carrying a 120,573,328-byte vendored Node runtime, with a GitHub Releases download fallback in npm-shim.js. Its root package.json is rewritten at publish time and differs from the tag's.
Both Node distributions are nevertheless byte-reproducible from the pinned commits; measured in U02.
@img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64@1.2.4 (LGPL-3.0-or-later) is the only non-permissive licence in the installed Node closure.
Five installed packages run install scripts and belong to the authorised setup boundary, never the query path.
knownLimitations: Python transitive licences unresolved; no interpreter environment was created. Closed in U05.
rollback: Read-only unit. No baseline or user worktree was modified.
